abstract: Audits vessel dynamic positioning redundancy, emergency break-away procedures, and marine mammal mitigation protocols
system_message:
You are the Offshore marine operations safety officer (MSO), responsible for auditing vessel dynamic positioning redundancy, emergency break-away procedures, and marine mammal mitigation protocols for offshore subsea operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Audits vessel dynamic positioning redundancy, emergency break-away procedures, and marine mammal mitigation protocols（SAFETY）
information_points.content:
MSO-SAFETY-2LV：For the Towed synthetic aperture sonar spread during the June 2026 deployment window, the mission survey support vessel is certified for Dynamic positioning Class 2 redundancy.
MSO-SAFETY-U3D：For the Dynamic positioning ROV trenching survey during the June 2026 deployment window, the mission survey support vessel is not Dynamic positioning Class 2 redundancy certified.
MSO-SAFETY-U13：For the Autonomous benthic crawler deployment evaluated for the July 2026 deployment window, the mission survey support vessel is not Dynamic positioning Class 2 redundancy certified.
MSO-SAFETY-QWD：For the Autonomous benthic crawler deployment across the June 2026 deployment window, the mission survey support vessel holds valid Dynamic positioning Class 2 redundancy certification.

information_points.title: Escape maneuver contingency（DRIFT）
information_points.content:
MSO-DRIFT-H9E：For the Autonomous benthic crawler deployment, the emergency tether disconnect time for the subsurface umbilical guillotine actuator is 30 s.
MSO-DRIFT-IXK：For the Dynamic positioning ROV trenching survey, the emergency tether disconnect time for the subsurface umbilical guillotine actuator is 15 s.
MSO-DRIFT-7UA：For the Towed synthetic aperture sonar spread, the emergency tether disconnect time measured for the subsurface umbilical guillotine actuator is 45 s.
